To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The DNA duplex (DD) is more stable than the RNA duplex (RR).
the structural and dynamic properties of DNA, RNA and hybrid oligonucleotides of identical sequences are different.

(i) the RNA duplex is less stable and more flexible than the DNA duplex; (ii) the RNA-DNA hybrid is more stable and less flexible than both the RNA duplex and the DNA duplex; and (iii) the DNA strand in the RNA-DNA duplex is more flexible than the RNA strand.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the structural and dynamic properties of RNA-DNA hybrids and the comparison of the results obtained with those of the corresponding DNA and RNA duplexes.

the structural and dynamic properties of a short RNA-DNA hybrid, which could be useful for the understanding of the mechanism of the RNA polymerase and the role of the DNA-RNA hybrids in the transcription process.
the structural and dynamic differences between DNA, RNA and hybrid DNA/RNA oligomers of the same sequence.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, although the hybrid RD sample is structurally and dynamically intermediate between DD and RR, the conformation of the RNA strand is preserved and the DNA strand is locally deformed.
the RNA-DNA hybrid is more flexible than the DNA-DNA duplex but less than the RNA-RNA duplex.
the RNA strand is more rigid than the DNA strand and the DNA-RNA hybrid is more rigid than both the RNA and DNA duplexes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, in the hybrid, the RNA strand is not affected by the DNA strand, while the DNA one shows some structural changes.
the RNA strand preserves its conformation in hybrid RNA-DNA, while the DNA conformation is locally deformed.
the RNA-DNA hybrid is a more flexible and less stable structure than the corresponding RNA or DNA duplexes, and this feature is related to the conformational differences of the individual strands.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the structural differences among the three samples are mainly due to the presence of RNA.
RNA and DNA duplexes of the same sequence have different conformations, dynamics and thermodynamic stabilities, and these differences are reflected in the hybrid.
RNA-DNA hybrids are more dynamic and less stable than their DNA or RNA counterparts.
